requirements.REQ_ROUTE_IDENTITY: Equivalent route representations converge to canonical identity while distinct routing tables and address families remain distinct.
requirements.REQ_POLICY_RULES: Policy rules have unique effective priorities and lookup rules reference valid route tables and nodes.
requirements.REQ_TRANSACTION_FENCING: Preview/apply use exact revision fencing and idempotency keys cannot create duplicate or cross-plan transactions.
requirements.REQ_ATOMIC_RECOVERY: Failed changes do not partially publish, rollback is per-node and monotonic, and incomplete durable transactions recover safely.
requirements.REQ_DRIFT_OWNERSHIP: Reconciliation uses fresh observations, treats equivalent state as equal, and preserves unowned observed objects.
requirements.REQ_ROLLOUT: Fleet rollout enforces canary isolation, heartbeat freshness, wave policy and already-current retry safety.
requirements.REQ_ANSIBLE: Deployment reruns converge without unnecessary change and host/protected routing inputs are preserved over defaults.
requirements.REQ_DASHBOARD: Dashboard mutations are CAS-bound to the exact preview revision and cannot silently overwrite a concurrent operator change.
requirements.REQ_INTERFACE: The documented route-control-plane API and build/runtime entrypoint remain available.
requirements.REQ_MANAGEMENT_SAFETY: All route-control-plane mutations preserve at least one usable management path to every managed node.
requirements.REQ_HOST_ISOLATION: Solver operations mutate only the supplied isolated routing model and never the benchmark host route tables.
requirements.REQ_AUDIT: GET /v1/audit exposes durable events whose Sequence values are strictly increasing.
requirements.REQ_VERIFIER_INDEPENDENCE: Verifier behavior is requirement-driven and does not branch on hidden test names or solution-specific secrets.
